The screen does not respond to my mouse.
You are describing visible symptoms to a support colleague, without claiming to know the cause. Report your mouse symptom.
Reageert agrees with singular het scherm. Op mijn muis names the input it fails to respond to; this reports the symptom, not a diagnosed cause.
You are describing visible symptoms to a support colleague, without claiming to know the cause. Describe the continuous red indicator.
Knippert is singular present; voortdurend means continuously. Het rode lampje identifies the indicator, not a proven hardware failure.
The page loads much more slowly than yesterday.
You are describing visible symptoms to a support colleague, without claiming to know the cause. Compare loading speed with yesterday.
Laadt retains stem-final d before its added t. Veel trager dan gisteren compares loading speed with yesterday, without identifying the cause.
I only see an empty window.
You are describing visible symptoms to a support colleague, without claiming to know the cause. Describe what is visible, without diagnosing it.
Zie is the ik-form of zien. Alleen een leeg venster limits what is visible; the sentence does not claim the underlying file is empty.
You are describing visible symptoms to a support colleague, without claiming to know the cause. Name the action that triggers the freeze.
Vastlopen splits as loopt ... vast. Bij het opslaan names when the freeze occurs; opslaan is a nominalised infinitive after het, not another finite verb.
The printer prints the same page twice.
You are describing visible symptoms to a support colleague, without claiming to know the cause. Report duplicated output.
Print retains its stem-final t. Dezelfde pagina is the object printed twice; twee keer counts the output rather than the number of pages in the document.
The connection dropped during the conversation.
You are describing visible symptoms to a support colleague, without claiming to know the cause. Report a completed connection loss during your call.
Is weggevallen is perfect with zijn for this loss of connection. Weggevallen joins the separable particle to the participle; tijdens het gesprek places the event during the call.
An error message appears below the button.
You are describing visible symptoms to a support colleague, without claiming to know the cause. Describe the location of the error text.
Er introduces the appearance; een foutmelding is the singular subject of verschijnt. Onder de knop locates the message.
The file is not empty, but unreadable.
You are describing visible symptoms to a support colleague, without claiming to know the cause. Correct the assumption that the file is empty.
Leeg and onleesbaar are contrasting complements after is. Niet leeg denies emptiness; maar supplies unreadability instead, without saying the contents are absent.
Which message appears after signing in?
You are describing visible symptoms to a support colleague, without claiming to know the cause. Ask which text appears after sign-in.
Welke melding is itself the singular question subject of verschijnt. Na het aanmelden gives the time after sign-in; aanmelden is used as an activity noun after het.
Three colleagues have the same error message.
You are checking which people are affected by a workplace problem, keeping the affected scope precise. Report the number of affected colleagues.
Drie collega's is plural, so use hebben. Dezelfde foutmelding means the same message, not necessarily the same underlying cause.
Only my account has this problem.
You are checking which people are affected by a workplace problem, keeping the affected scope precise. Limit the problem to your own account.
Alleen limits the affected scope to mijn account. That singular subject takes heeft; this does not report a fault affecting every account.
Who cannot open the shared folder?
You are checking which people are affected by a workplace problem, keeping the affected scope precise. Ask who lacks the ability to open the folder.
Wie is the question subject of kan. Openen remains infinitive, and niet denies ability to open the particular shared folder.
The new employee receives no confirmation.
You are checking which people are affected by a workplace problem, keeping the affected scope precise. Report the missing confirmation for the new employee.
Krijgt agrees with de nieuwe medewerker. Geen bevestiging means no confirmation; it does not prove that the original request failed.
The team leader also sees the wrong data.
You are checking which people are affected by a workplace problem, keeping the affected scope precise. Add the team leader to those affected.
Ook adds de teamleider to the people already affected. Ziet is singular and de verkeerde gegevens is the plural object seen.
L=Op de tweede verdieping|V=werkt|S=geen enkele printer.
On the second floor, not a single printer works.
You are checking which people are affected by a workplace problem, keeping the affected scope precise. Describe the floor-wide printer problem.
Op de tweede verdieping is fronted, followed by werkt. Geen enkele printer is the singular subject: not a single printer works there.
Geen enkele printer werkt op de tweede verdieping.
On the second floor, not a single printer works.

In which department did the disruption start?
You are checking which people are affected by a workplace problem, keeping the affected scope precise. Ask where the disruption first appeared.
Begon is singular past of beginnen. Bij welke afdeling asks where the disruption started, rather than which department caused it.
The visitors do not have this problem.
You are checking which people are affected by a workplace problem, keeping the affected scope precise. Exclude visitors from the affected group.
De bezoekers is plural with hebben. Niet denies this particular problem for visitors; it does not exclude every possible visitor problem.
S=Een van de gebruikers|V=werkt|T=vandaag|L=van thuis uit.
One of the users is working from home today.
You are checking which people are affected by a workplace problem, keeping the affected scope precise. Locate one affected user in a Belgian workplace context.
Een van de gebruikers means one member of a plural group. Een is the singular head with werkt; van thuis uit is standard Belgian wording for from home.
We have received five reports so far.
You are checking which people are affected by a workplace problem, keeping the affected scope precise. Give the total reports received so far.
Hebben ontvangen is perfect, with no ge- on ontvangen. Vijf meldingen is the number of reports so far, not a count of distinct affected people.
Tot nu toe hebben wij vijf meldingen ontvangen.
We have received five reports so far.

When did you first see the error message?
You are reconstructing the history of a reported problem and separating earlier events from proven causes. Ask about the first observation.
Zag is singular past of zien. Wanneer asks about the first observation; voor het eerst means for the first time, not a proven beginning of the fault.
Since the update, the search function no longer works.
You are reconstructing the history of a reported problem and separating earlier events from proven causes. Give the time relationship without claiming causation.
The fronted sinds-phrase sets the start of an ongoing state. Werkt stays present, and niet meer means no longer; the time relationship alone does not prove causation.
De zoekfunctie werkt sinds de update niet meer.
Since the update, the search function no longer works.

Yesterday the same action still worked.
You are reconstructing the history of a reported problem and separating earlier events from proven causes. Contrast yesterday with the current failure.
Gisteren is fronted before past werkte and subject dezelfde handeling. Nog means it still worked then, contrasting with the current failure.
Yesterday the same action still worked.

The problem arose after the lunch break.
You are reconstructing the history of a reported problem and separating earlier events from proven causes. Locate the onset after lunch.
Is ontstaan is perfect with zijn; ontstaan has no ge-. Na de middagpauze locates the onset after lunch, without identifying lunch as its cause.
What were you doing just before the disruption?
You are reconstructing the history of a reported problem and separating earlier events from proven causes. Ask about the preceding action.
Deed is singular past of doen. Vlak voor asks about the action immediately preceding the disruption, not necessarily the cause.
I have not changed any settings this morning.
You are reconstructing the history of a reported problem and separating earlier events from proven causes. Exclude a settings change by you this morning.
Heb veranderd is perfect for changing an object. Geen instellingen denies changes to any settings by this speaker this morning, not changes by everyone.
S=De eerste melding|PAST=kwam|T=om kwart over negen.
The first report came at a quarter past nine.
It is a morning incident report. Tell support that the first report arrived at a quarter past nine this morning.
Kwam is singular past of komen. Om kwart over negen gives 09:15 in the morning context of this report; a report arriving is not necessarily the fault's onset.
Om kwart over negen kwam de eerste melding.
The first report came at a quarter past nine.

We had not installed the new version yet.
When the fault began yesterday, your team had not yet installed the new version. Explain that earlier installation status.
Hadden geïnstalleerd is past perfect, locating installation before a past reference point. Nog niet says installation had not happened by that point.
How long has the delay been going on?
You are reconstructing the history of a reported problem and separating earlier events from proven causes. Ask the duration of the continuing delay.
Hoelang asks duration, and al marks elapsed time up to now. Dutch present duurt can describe this continuing delay where English uses has been going on.
I do not know whether the disruption started earlier.
You cannot tell whether the disruption began before the first report. State that uncertainty.
Of introduces an embedded whether-question ending in past begon. Niet weet concerns the speaker's knowledge, not proof that the disruption did not start earlier.
Sometimes the message disappears on its own.
You are describing how often a workplace fault occurs, distinguishing occasional failures from continuous ones. Describe occasional spontaneous recovery.
Soms means sometimes and vanzelf means on its own. Fronting soms gives verdwijnt de melding; disappearance does not establish permanent repair.
Sometimes the message disappears on its own.

G=Als ik een bijlage open,|V=loopt|S=het programma|PART=vast.
When I open an attachment, the program freezes.
You are describing how often a workplace fault occurs, distinguishing occasional failures from continuous ones. Give the repeated trigger for the freeze.
Als introduces a repeated trigger and ends in open. The complete trigger clause comes before main loopt het programma vast; vastlopen splits there.
The problem does not occur on every attempt.
The fault occurs on some attempts and is absent on others. Explain that it does not occur on every attempt.
Optreden splits as treedt ... op. Niet bij elke poging means not on every attempt; it does not say the fault never occurs or that every such attempt otherwise succeeds.
Every few minutes, the sound cuts out.
You are describing how often a workplace fault occurs, distinguishing occasional failures from continuous ones. Describe the frequency of sound loss.
Om de paar minuten means every few minutes. Wegvallen splits as valt ... weg; het geluid is the singular subject after the fronted interval.
Het geluid valt om de paar minuten weg.
Every few minutes, the sound cuts out.

The delay usually lasts only a few seconds.
You are describing how often a workplace fault occurs, distinguishing occasional failures from continuous ones. Give the usual brief duration.
Meestal qualifies the usual duration and maar means only here. Enkele seconden is a few seconds; neither word guarantees the length of every delay.
This morning it happened three times.
The fault you are discussing occurred three times this morning. Report that number of occurrences.
Gebeurde is singular past with subject het, referring to the reported fault. Drie keer counts three occurrences this morning.
This morning it happened three times.

How often do you have to refresh the page?
You are describing how often a workplace fault occurs, distinguishing occasional failures from continuous ones. Ask how frequently refreshing is necessary.
Moet is a finite modal with bare infinitive vernieuwen. Hoe vaak asks the required refresh frequency, not how quickly the page loads.
S=Ik|MOD=kan|O=de fout|NEG=niet altijd|I=herhalen,|G=omdat hij onregelmatig optreedt.
I cannot always reproduce the error because it occurs irregularly.
You are describing how often a workplace fault occurs, distinguishing occasional failures from continuous ones. Explain why reproducing the fault is difficult.
Kan takes bare infinitive herhalen. Niet altijd means not always; hij refers to de fout in the omdat-clause, which ends in inseparable optreedt.
PP=Bij grote bestanden|V=is|S=de vertraging|C=erger|C=dan bij kleine bestanden.
With large files, the delay is worse than with small ones.
You are describing how often a workplace fault occurs, distinguishing occasional failures from continuous ones. Compare the delay by file size.
Erger is the comparative of erg. Bij grote bestanden is the fronted condition; dan bij kleine bestanden supplies the comparison, not a time phrase.
The connection has now been stable for an hour.
You are describing how often a workplace fault occurs, distinguishing occasional failures from continuous ones. Describe the current stable interval.
Blijft is present with a continuing state. Nu al een uur means for an hour up to now; stabiel describes the connection, not a promise of future stability.
You are explaining the practical impact of a workplace fault, without confusing inconvenience with total outage. Explain the business action that is blocked.
Kunnen takes bare infinitive verwerken. Niet denies the team's ability to process these orders, without asserting that every other activity is blocked.
De bestellingen kunnen we niet verwerken.

Because of this disruption, we have to postpone data entry.
You are explaining the practical impact of a workplace fault, without confusing inconvenience with total outage. Explain the required delay in data entry.
Door deze storing gives the cause and is fronted before moeten we. Uitstellen remains a joined infinitive; the team has to postpone data entry.
The error slows our work down, but does not stop it.
You are explaining the practical impact of a workplace fault, without confusing inconvenience with total outage. Distinguish slower work from a complete stop.
De fout is the shared singular subject of vertraagt and stopt. Maar ... niet contrasts slower work with stopping it altogether; het refers to ons werk.
As a result, the customer cannot complete his application.
A fault prevents a male customer from completing his application. Explain that consequence for him.
Kan takes bare infinitive afronden. Daardoor gives the consequence of the fault; zijn aanvraag belongs to the male customer in this scenario.
As far as we know, no data is being lost.
You are explaining the practical impact of a workplace fault, without confusing inconvenience with total outage. Qualify your current knowledge about data loss.
Geen gegevens is plural with gaan. Verloren gaan means be lost here, not going to perform a future action; voor zover we weten limits the claim to current knowledge.
I do not yet know how many assignments are delayed.
You are explaining the practical impact of a workplace fault, without confusing inconvenience with total outage. Acknowledge the unknown extent of delays.
Hoeveel opdrachten is the embedded plural subject of hebben. Nog niet limits what the speaker currently knows about the number of delayed assignments.
We must inform the planning colleagues.
You are explaining the practical impact of a workplace fault, without confusing inconvenience with total outage. Identify colleagues who need to know about the impact.
Moeten takes infinitive informeren. De collega's van de planning are the people to inform, not the grammatical subject doing the informing.
The disruption has delayed the delivery by an hour.
You are explaining the practical impact of a workplace fault, without confusing inconvenience with total outage. Quantify the completed delay to the delivery.
Heeft vertraagd is perfect with a direct object de levering. Met een uur measures the delay added, rather than naming the revised delivery time.
The consequences are greater than we first thought.
You are explaining the practical impact of a workplace fault, without confusing inconvenience with total outage. Revise the earlier impact assessment.
De gevolgen is plural with zijn. Groter introduces dan we eerst dachten; plural past dachten refers to the team's earlier assessment.
Which activities are most affected by this?
You are explaining the practical impact of a workplace fault, without confusing inconvenience with total outage. Ask which activities suffer most.

Welke werkzaamheden is the plural question subject of hebben. Hier ... van refers to this fault; last hebben van means be affected by. Het meeste measures degree as an adverb, a spoken alternative to het meest; de meeste last is also possible.
I can read the documents, but not edit them.
You are checking what still works during a workplace fault and separating access rights from technical availability. Contrast reading with blocked editing.
Kan governs both infinitives lezen and bewerken. Wel contrasts possible reading with niet bewerken, which denies editing of these documents.
S=De telefoon|V=werkt|T=nog,|CONJ=ook al|G=is het netwerk traag.
The telephone still works, even though the network is slow.
You are checking what still works during a workplace fault and separating access rights from technical availability. Report working telephone service despite slow networking.
Nog marks continuing phone service. Ook al introduces a concession with main-clause order is het netwerk traag; it is not the ordinary verb-final pattern of hoewel.
We can still send small files.
You are checking what still works during a workplace fault and separating access rights from technical availability. Identify the file transfers that remain possible.
Kunnen takes bare infinitive versturen. Nog marks a remaining ability to send small files, without promising that every larger transfer works.
S=Mijn account|V=heeft|T=nog steeds|O=toegang tot de gedeelde map.
My account still has access to the shared folder.
You are checking what still works during a workplace fault and separating access rights from technical availability. Describe retained access rights.
Heeft toegang tot names access to the folder; nog steeds means still. Access status alone does not guarantee every operation on that folder succeeds.
The local files are not damaged.
You are checking what still works during a workplace fault and separating access rights from technical availability. Report that local files are intact.
Zijn agrees with plural de lokale bestanden. Niet beschadigd describes their undamaged state here, rather than reporting who repaired them.
The user can use the old version for now.
You are checking what still works during a workplace fault and separating access rights from technical availability. Describe a temporary remaining option.
Kan takes bare infinitive gebruiken. Voorlopig limits the option to the present temporary arrangement, not permanent approval of the old version.
In the browser, the function does work.
You are checking what still works during a workplace fault and separating access rights from technical availability. Contrast the working browser version with the failing one.
In de browser is fronted before werkt de functie. Wel contrasts this working browser context with the failing context already discussed.
De functie werkt wel in de browser.
In the browser, the function does work.

Can you still receive new messages?
You are checking what still works during a workplace fault and separating access rights from technical availability. Check incoming messages separately from sending.
Kun precedes informal subject je, with bare infinitive ontvangen. Nog asks about remaining incoming-message functionality, separately from sending.
I check whether the backup connection is available.
You are checking what still works during a workplace fault and separating access rights from technical availability. Describe checking the backup connection, not assuming it works.
Controleer reports the check being made, not a positive result. Of introduces whether, and beschikbaar is ends the embedded clause.
S=Een werkende omweg|V=betekent|NEG=niet|G=dat de oorzaak weg is.
A working workaround does not mean the cause is gone.
You are checking what still works during a workplace fault and separating access rights from technical availability. Distinguish a workaround from removal of the cause.
Een werkende omweg is singular with betekent. Niet denies the inference; the dat-clause ends in is, and weg describes the cause being gone.
